Unpopular opinion: turn-based combat beats action combat.

Persona 5 proves turn-based can be stylish and fast. Every menu feels like a music video. Final Fantasy X lets you think. Swapping party members mid-fight is strategy, not button mashing. Baldur's Gate 3 won Game of the Year with turns. Still think turn-based is outdated? Agree?
